{{recipe}}

'''Stuffed zucchini''' can be served as an [[Cookbook:Appetizers|appetizer]] or as a side dish.

==Ingredients==
* 6 [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]] (courgettes)
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (280 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] frozen [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]], thawed and drained
* 2 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 8–10 oz (220–280 g) button [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]] (canned or fresh), finely chopped
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], lightly beaten
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Paprika|Paprika]]
* 4 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (180°C).
# Trim ends of zucchini and [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], covered, for 5 minutes. Drain and cover.
# Cut in half lengthwise.
# Scoop out pulp, leaving a ¼ inch (0.75 cm) shell. [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] the removed pulp.
# Heat olive oil in [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]].
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] zucchini pulp, spinach, onions, and garlic for 5 minutes.
# Add mushrooms and sauté another 3 minutes.
# Remove from heat, add eggs, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
# Spoon filling into shells.
# Sprinkle with paprika.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 30 minutes.
